# London Boroughs — what's on in the London boroughs beyond the centre

> Listings and news for the outer London boroughs — Hackney, Wandsworth, Sutton, Southwark, Newham and their neighbours, not central London. Every entry names the source it came from and the day it was checked against it. Independent publication: not a government outlet, not a ticket seller, not affiliated with any venue.

How this site works, in five rules:

- **Every fact names where it came from, and when we last looked.** The source prints as text, never as a live link.
- **Nothing is listed on a date we could not confirm.** If the organiser said "early November" and nothing more, no invented day appears here — the missing day appears instead.
- **What's on, not what went wrong.** No politics, no crime, no tragedy.
- **We pick the best, and say why.** Picking out the best of something is the job; running a named business down is not.
- **A page exists when there is something to put on it.** No empty templates waiting for content.

## What a reader finds here

- [Events](https://lnd.lol/events/): events on dates confirmed with the organiser, with times, prices and running order where the organiser published them.
- [News](https://lnd.lol/news/): what changed in the city. Long pieces carrying the whole calendar or the whole figure, not a wire paragraph.
- [About](https://lnd.lol/about/): the rules above, written out at length.

## Where the facts come from

The borough press, or the organiser: Hackney Citizen, Wandsworth Guardian, East London Advertiser, Sutton Guardian, Southwark News, This Is Local London. Each entry prints that name and the date it was verified. Venue coordinates are geocoded once and stored in the data; where the geocoder returns the wrong place, the entry publishes without a map rather than with a wrong one.

Where a voice from Reddit appears in the text, it is a direct quotation from a public post, attributed to the subreddit rather than to the person.

What has not been announced is said to be unannounced. A closing date nobody has given, a theme not yet confirmed and a running order still to come are three things this site names rather than fills in.

## Events

- [GALA 2027, Peckham Rye Park](https://lnd.lol/events/gala-festival-peckham-rye-2027/): South London's independent dance festival is back in Peckham Rye Park over the late May bank holiday, 28–30 May 2027, with Four Tet, HAAi, Shy FX and DJ Harvey announced; presale tickets from 10am on Friday 30 October 2026.
- [London Parade on New Year's Day 2027](https://lnd.lol/events/london-parade-new-years-day-2027/): The free London Parade crosses Westminster from Piccadilly to Parliament Square on 1 January, with marching bands, dance groups and borough entries.
- [Peter Pan Cup 2026: the Serpentine's Christmas Day race](https://lnd.lol/events/peter-pan-cup-serpentine-christmas-day-2026/): London's oldest Christmas morning tradition: the Serpentine Swimming Club races 100 yards across the lake in Hyde Park for the Peter Pan Cup, on Friday 25 December 2026 at 9am. Free to watch from the bank.
- [Christmas at Eltham Palace 2026: the fair and Father Christmas](https://lnd.lol/events/christmas-at-eltham-palace-2026/): Christmas at Eltham Palace, in the Royal Borough of Greenwich in south-east London: a makers' fair in the medieval Great Hall on 5 and 6 December 2026, included with admission, and Father Christmas on every weekend from 5 to 20 December, at £15 a child, or £12 for English Heritage members.
- [Jack and the Beanstalk, Hackney Empire's pantomime 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/jack-and-the-beanstalk-hackney-empire-panto-2026/): Hackney Empire's 2026 pantomime in east London is Jack and the Beanstalk, from 21 November to 31 December, with Clive Rowe directing and playing Dame Trot and Kat B as Simple Simon. Seats are £10 to £48, for all ages, with BSL-interpreted, relaxed and audio-described performances.
- [Hampton Court Palace ice rink 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/hampton-court-palace-ice-rink-2026/): Skating in front of Henry VIII's palace in south-west London from 20 November 2026 to 3 January 2027, first session 10am and last 8pm, closed Christmas Day; a separate ticket from palace admission, with quieter morning sessions daily.
- [Santa's Winter Garden at Fulham Palace 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/santas-winter-garden-fulham-palace-2026/): New for Christmas 2026 in south-west London: Fulham Palace's walled garden becomes a snowy trail ending in a private visit to Santa, 20 November to 23 December, from £38 a child and £20 an adult at the quietest times.
- [Queen's House Ice Rink 2026, Greenwich](https://lnd.lol/events/queens-house-ice-rink-greenwich-2026/): Greenwich's open-air ice rink in front of the Queen's House returns from 18 November 2026 to 3 January 2027, 11am to 9pm, closed on Christmas Day, with sessions for toddlers, students and SEND families — one of London's quieter Christmas rinks.
- [Lord Mayor's Show 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/lord-mayors-show-2026-london-boroughs/): The City of London's free Lord Mayor's Show returns on Saturday 14 November: an eight-century civic procession starting from Mansion House at 11am.
- [EFG London Jazz Festival 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/efg-london-jazz-festival-2026/): Ten days of jazz across London, 13–22 November: headline concerts, free family performances and The Jazz Social beside the Barbican.
- [Christmas at Kew 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/christmas-at-kew-2026/): Kew Gardens' after-dark light trail in south-west London runs on selected nights from 13 November to 3 January, with timed entry, new installations and adult-only evenings.
- [Blackheath Fireworks 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/blackheath-fireworks-2026/): South-east London's biggest firework display returns to Blackheath Common on Saturday 7 November, 5pm to 10pm, ticketed, with adult entry at £17.60 and a capacity of forty thousand.
- [Alexandra Palace Fireworks & Drone Festival 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/alexandra-palace-fireworks-2026/): Fireworks and a drone show over north London from Alexandra Palace on Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November 2026: an 8pm display and a German Bier Festival on the Saturday, a 6pm display for families on the Sunday. Gates open at 4pm.
- [Battersea Park Fireworks 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/battersea-park-fireworks-2026/): Wandsworth's fireworks return to Battersea Park in south-west London on Saturday 7 and Sunday 8 November 2026: an 8.30pm display with a Rudimental DJ set on Saturday, a 7pm display on Sunday. Advance tickets only, £18 for adults on Saturday and £16.70 on Sunday.
- [Fireworks in the Park 2026: Wimbledon Park and Morden Park](https://lnd.lol/events/merton-fireworks-in-the-park-2026/): Merton's Fireworks in the Park in south-west London: Wimbledon Park on Thursday 5 November 2026 and Morden Park on Saturday 7 November, two shows each night at 6.45pm and 8.30pm. Adults £15.90, children £11.66.
- [Fireworks Night at Coram's Fields 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/corams-fields-fireworks-night-2026/): A free fireworks display on Bonfire Night in central London: Coram's Fields, the children's park in Bloomsbury, opens at 3.30pm on Thursday 5 November 2026 for fireworks at 6pm. No ticket needed, but adults only with a child.
- [Day of the Dead at the Horniman 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/day-of-the-dead-horniman-2026/): Aztec dancers open the Horniman's Day of the Dead in south-east London on Saturday 31 October, 11am to 4pm, with mariachi, a community ofrenda and a MexiBrit market — and an adults' fiesta at 7pm.
- [Halloween Fireworks at Herne Hill Velodrome 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/herne-hill-velodrome-halloween-fireworks-2026/): A bonfire, fire-eaters and fireworks over Herne Hill Velodrome in south London on Saturday 31 October 2026: gates at 5pm, bonfire at 6, fireworks at 7. Adults £13, under-12s £1, advance tickets only.
- [Halloween at Hampton Court Palace 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/halloween-hampton-court-palace-2026/): Henry VIII's haunted palace, 24 October to 1 November: ghosts and projections indoors, a pumpkin trail in the Wilderness and storytelling six times a day, all included with admission — in the London borough of Richmond upon Thames.
- [Halloween at the Royal Observatory 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/halloween-royal-observatory-greenwich-2026/): Halloween in London at the Royal Observatory, in its last week before it closes on 2 November: a 45-minute Ghastly Greenwich tour at 4pm on 24, 27, 28 and 29 October, and a free pumpkin trail every day. Entry £24, children £12.
- [Halloween half-term at Eltham Palace 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/halloween-eltham-palace-2026/): The Great Pumpkin Party runs 24 October to 1 November, 10am to 4pm, at the art deco palace in south-east London — storytelling, a themed trail and a fancy dress contest every day.
- [SUPER Natural at WWT London 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/super-natural-wwt-london-2026/): The Wetland Centre at Barnes, in south-west London, answers Halloween with willow wands, a marshland potion and a fungi hunt from 24 October to 1 November — scare-free, and included with admission.
- [Halloween at Strawberry Hill House 2026: Walpole's Gothic castle after dark](https://lnd.lol/events/halloween-strawberry-hill-house-2026/): Horace Walpole's Gothic castle in Twickenham keeps Halloween properly: a candlelit late on Saturday 31 October 2026 from 6pm, £25 with a glass of fizz for anyone in costume, a supernatural guided tour that day and a £2 garden trail all half-term. Strawberry Hill House is in the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames.
- [Curse of the Mummy at The London Dungeon 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/curse-of-the-mummy-london-dungeon-2026/): The London Dungeon's Halloween show runs from 17 October to 1 November in Lambeth, included in the standard ticket from £27 online, and built on a real Victorian legend from a London museum.
- [1-54 Contemporary African Art Fair 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/one-54-somerset-house-2026/): The fair takes three wings of Somerset House from 15 to 18 October, its fourteenth consecutive London edition, with a monumental installation standing in the Fountain Court.
- [Ski Sunday in Surbiton 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/ski-sunday-surbiton-2026/): Two hours of suburban skiing down St Mark's Hill in south-west London on Sunday 11 October, free to watch and free to enter, bathtubs permitted and over-18s only.
- [The Nightmare Realm at Avery Hill 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/the-nightmare-realm-avery-hill-2026/): Halloween scare attractions in south-east London: The Nightmare Realm fills Avery Hill Mansion in Greenwich on 18 nights from 9 October to 1 November 2026. Best from 13; free parking.
- [Japan Matsuri at Trafalgar Square](https://lnd.lol/events/japan-matsuri-trafalgar-square-2026/): Seventeen years, three addresses and one afternoon a year: London's Japanese festival has occupied Trafalgar Square since 2012, and returns on the first Sunday of October.
- [Howl'o'ween at Chessington 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/howl-o-ween-chessington-2026/): A theme park Halloween inside the London boundary: selected dates from 3 October to 1 November in Kingston upon Thames, with new shows, a vampire's lair and rides at dusk, from £34 online.
- [Hobbledown Heath Pumpkin Patch 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/hobbledown-heath-pumpkin-patch-2026/): The longest Halloween run in any London borough this year: a pumpkin patch beside the River Crane in Hounslow, open from 25 September to 1 November, from £7.50 with the pumpkin charged separately.
- [Lambeth Fringe 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/lambeth-fringe-2026/): Five weeks of theatre, comedy, cabaret and music in the pubs, chapels and small theatres of one south London borough, from 24 September to 25 October.
- [Dark Arts at Warner Bros. Studio Tour London 2026](https://lnd.lol/events/dark-arts-warner-bros-studio-tour-2026/): The studio tour's Halloween season runs 16 September to 8 November, with more than a hundred floating pumpkins over the Great Hall — an hour out of London, included in the standard ticket, and the ticket must be booked in advance.
- [The Big Brine](https://lnd.lol/events/the-big-brine-hackney-bridge/): Two days at Hackney Bridge in east London given over to everything fermented, pickled and brined, with chef demos and live music. 12–13 September 2026.
- [The Giant Summer Flea](https://lnd.lol/events/giant-summer-flea-olympic-park/): A one-day flea market at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park in east London, Sunday 6 September 2026.

## News

- [Theo's opens a third pizzeria on Rye Lane, Peckham, on 6 November](https://lnd.lol/news/theos-pizza-opens-on-rye-lane-peckham/): The south London pizzeria from Elephant & Castle and Camberwell opens its third room at 285 Rye Lane, Peckham, at 6pm on Friday 6 November 2026, after half-price soft-launch nights.
- [Lord Mayor's Show 2026: what is on across the City](https://lnd.lol/news/lord-mayors-show-2026-route-and-viewing-guide/): Plan Saturday 14 November in the City of London: the free Lord Mayor's procession, Guildhall Art Gallery and afternoon walking tours, with times, locations and maps.
- [Zula opens a second burger restaurant in Spitalfields on 1 November](https://lnd.lol/news/zula-opens-in-spitalfields-on-1-november/): The Marble Arch burger restaurant opens a fast-service sibling at 2e Lamb Street, east London, on Sunday 1 November, with a Spitalfields Wagyu burger the original does not serve.
- [Coqfighter opens at Market Halls Canary Wharf on 21 October](https://lnd.lol/news/coqfighter-opens-at-market-halls-canary-wharf/): The Australian-born Korean fried chicken takes its fifth London counter, at Market Halls, 25 North Colonnade, from Wednesday 21 October.
- [The florist that dresses Claridge's has a shop on Brook's Mews](https://lnd.lol/news/claridges-flowers-is-on-brooks-mews/): One of the quieter addresses in Mayfair: the working flower room that supplies a London hotel opens to the street, and sells stems singly as well as by the armful.
- [Thirteen ordinary Finnish buildings just got the same protection as a cathedral](https://lnd.lol/news/unesco-lists-thirteen-buildings-by-alvar-aalto/): UNESCO's July session put libraries, workplaces and housing on the World Heritage List — an argument about what deserves keeping that outer London hears every time an estate comes up for demolition.
- [A British research archive decided whether a drug trial in China had touched ageing at all](https://lnd.lol/news/the-uk-biobank-yardstick-behind-an-ageing-drug-trial/): A China drug trial used 55,319 UK Biobank records as its normal-ageing baseline. For London readers, the shared training data is the key caveat.
- [Claude now watermarks its writing, and the interesting part is where the mark runs out](https://lnd.lol/news/what-claudes-new-watermark-cannot-tell-you/): For London readers assessing AI text, Anthropic's invisible Claude watermark weakens on short, factual or code-heavy passages and disappears after paraphrase.
- [The London Design Festival has eleven districts, and not one of them is a building](https://lnd.lol/news/eleven-design-districts-and-not-one-of-them-is-a-venue/): The 24th London Design Festival runs 12 to 20 September across eleven neighbourhood districts, from Walthamstow to Park Royal, with landmark installations including one inside St Paul's.
- [After 349 years, the Monument may finally get somewhere to explain itself](https://lnd.lol/news/the-monument-may-finally-get-a-visitor-centre/): The brutalist block beside the Monument in the City of London is coming down, and the ground floor of what replaces it is set aside for a cultural and visitor centre — with an exhibition about the Great Fire, and a café.
- [Nineteen boroughs give a Sunday to the bicycle](https://lnd.lol/news/nineteen-boroughs-close-a-road-for-a-bicycle/): The London Cycling Festival runs on 20 September across 19 boroughs, with more than 30 led rides, four hubs and closed loops in Westminster and Tower Hamlets. Free, but ticketed.
- [Saturn’s south pole has drawn itself a decagon](https://lnd.lol/news/a-ten-sided-wave-at-saturns-south-pole/): For London readers following astronomy: Hubble confirms a strengthening ten-sided wave at Saturn's south pole, distinct from the stable northern hexagon.
- [The London Marathon will be run twice, on consecutive days, once only](https://lnd.lol/news/the-marathon-runs-twice-in-2027/): Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 April 2027: the London Marathon runs twice, 100,000 people over the same Greenwich-to-Westminster route, after 1.33 million entered the 2026 ballot.
- [Oxford Street loses its traffic in the second half of October](https://lnd.lol/news/oxford-street-goes-traffic-free/): Nine hundred metres of central London from Orchard Street to Great Portland Street, including Oxford Circus, close to buses, taxis, cycles and everything else on wheels.
- [For nine days, buildings that are never open, open](https://lnd.lol/news/open-house-festival-turns-35/): The 35th Open House runs 12–20 September across all 33 London boroughs, free. Booking opened at midday on 19 August, but a great deal needs no booking at all.
- [Two north London bus routes are being redrawn — and one goes](https://lnd.lol/news/bus-routes-67-and-149-consultation/): TfL proposes withdrawing the 67 and rerouting the 149 in north-east London. Edmonton Green loses a direct link and peak waits go from seven minutes to eight. It closes 20 September.
- [A hundred events and a light work on a bridge that carries nothing](https://lnd.lol/news/totally-thames-2026/): Through September the London stretch of the river hosts 100-plus events from Richmond to Barking and Dagenham, including Catherine Yass's work on Blackfriars' disused columns.
- [Fifteen years, four trillion dollars, and a closing balance](https://lnd.lol/news/fifteen-years-of-apple-in-numbers/): For London readers tracking Big Tech: Tim Cook's 15 years at Apple end with a $4tn market value, $416bn revenue and 60% lower absolute emissions.
- [Venice has programmed a film of two hundred and ten minutes](https://lnd.lol/news/venice-has-programmed-a-film-of-210-minutes/): For London filmgoers following Venice, the 2026 competition's 210-minute Dau leads a 20-film lineup at the 83rd festival.
- [The Superloop reaches Havering on 5 September](https://lnd.lol/news/sl12-superloop-gants-hill-rainham/): The SL12 Superloop runs Gants Hill to Rainham across east London from 5 September, free for its first week, and cuts a journey of just over an hour down to about forty minutes.
- [Which lines are shut over the bank holiday](https://lnd.lol/news/bank-holiday-tube-and-tfl-closures/): The Northern line is out above Archway, the Windrush line is on buses south of Canada Water, and Barons Court loses its westbound trains until November. The full outer-London list.
- [East Summer School returns to the Olympic Park](https://lnd.lol/news/olympic-park-summer-school/): Three hundred young people, twenty-four workshops, six institutions from BBC Music Studios to ABBA Voyage — and the only entry requirement is living or studying in one of four east London boroughs.
- [An eclipse read through seven graves in Bow](https://lnd.lol/news/eclipse-walk-tower-hamlets-cemetery-park/): The Friends of Tower Hamlets Cemetery Park in east London built a walk around the 12 August eclipse, using tree canopies as pinhole projectors and seven 19th-century graves as the route.
